body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit line within weapon range. Compare this Action against each enemy in the line. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage to that enemy.

surges.html: One affected enemy suffers -1 Defense until its next turn.
One affected enemy burns 1 die on its next Action.

rider.title: SUPPRESSION
rider.html: If your Locked target is affected, it cannot make Reactions against Ballistics Actions until the start of its next turn.
